_note: Pattern indices map to the Teensy flat bank (runPattern() in main.cpp). 0–7 are the operator/button bank (shared with switches). 8–10 are the fire-ritual finale (dimAmbient/fireFull/idleAmbient). 11–14 are question-reaction patterns (wormYes/wormNo/scrunch/fold). Optional yes.label / no.label override the default 'Yes' / 'No' button text.
_disabled_note: Parked while the MAX4466 mic is unwired: the mic riddle is removed from the live pool. To re-enable, move the entry from _disabled_questions back into questions[]. The firmware reads ONLY questions[]; _disabled_questions is ignored. Data-only change — re-run `pio run -t uploadfs` to apply.

_disabled_questions.q: I have no mouth, but I hear every word. I have no ears, but I catch every sound. Speak to me, and the lights will dance. What am I?
